target: Clinical studies blog article images (card + social image), set by scripts/build-clinical-studies-blog.py --apply
decided_by: Claude, on Malcolm's instruction (2026-09-30): "you make the initial choices for all the study blog images" — his standing rule for the blog is no model or product-branding images (2026-09-29). Picked from the unused science-image pool (configs/banners/clinical-studies-card-image-pool-2026-09-29.json; numbered sheets by scripts/study-card-pool-sheets.py), 'No person, no product' group only. Malcolm reviews on the live page and can swap any card by pool number.
why: One image per study, in its ingredient's colour (copper blue, Argireline grey, PDRN rose), each a different subject, balanced dark/light across the list: Badenhorst CU-013 (lab bench, dark), Raikou ARG-031 (skin surface at cell scale for a roughness study, light), Wang ARG-110 (peptide crystals on a dark slide), Ye PDRN-213 (DNA-like strands in pink gel: PDRN is DNA fragments; the double-helix candidates were rejected because PDRN-082 crosses its strands inconsistently, which no real helix does).
note: 3:2 crops at native resolution (no upscaling), JPEG q90; ARG-110 cropped to (70, 260, 1975, 1530) to drop the slide's grey edges. Checked at full size and at card size. New filenames (Shopify suffixes, never replaces, an existing name); none prefixes another file's name.
